text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, this is sudden, YES, but I have a 
favor to ask!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The NHK Mile Cup! Instead of just 
watching! Won't you run it together with 
El!?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Noooo, it's still no good~?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, at this rate, El is going to... 
El-El is gonna~...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Could you... come with me for a bit? To 
the training grounds.

I decided to go along with El Condor Pasa, 
who had suddenly thrown an absurd request 
at me.
And right there...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah, I'm not gonna lose, Sei-chan!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
"Right, come on, chase after me, chase 
after me... Draw them in till the very 
last second—and now!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Haa, haa, I was so... close, too~...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff... Got 'em~!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*... Today was merely 
practice! A true elite turns the tables 
with a brilliant comeback at the Satsuki 
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems we still have plenty of 
challenges before the big day.

There stood rivals, honing each other's 
skills through competition.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Look at this! Such passionate, precious, 
overflowing exchanges!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Watching this makes my blood boil! It 
makes El want a rival too!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, that is right! But everyone is 
aiming for the Classic Triple Crown, so no 
one is running alongside El."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Papa told me. In lucha libre matches, many 
luchadores compete with high-flying 
techniques!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
By getting fired up with the thought, 
"I'll jump higher than her!", even more 
splendid techniques are born!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And yet, El has no rival to compete 
against...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, is this really okay?! Can you 
really call this pro wrestling?!
choice_data_list: It's a race, not pro wrestling, but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Well Trainer-san, would you like to run in 
a race!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then how about we just do the Winning Pro 
Wrestling!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Then what is El supposed to do with this! 
This! Tightly! Clenched! Iron! Fist!

El Condor Pasa seemed disheartened that 
there were no rivals to run alongside her 
in the real event.
If there is a way, there's only one—
choice_data_list: Want to switch to the Triple Crown route?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
In...? N-No, I'm not thinking about that 
death.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
El's goal is strictly to conquer the Japan 
Cup in the Classic year!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The dream of the world's wild Condor will 
never waver!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I really want to race with my 
rival, yes! What should I do...
choice_data_list:
Can't it wait until after the Classics are 
over?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's right! Next year, we can run 
together...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, but that will be too late, YES! The 
battle must be settled as early as 
possible!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ah, that's right! If it's come to this...!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
King, King—! Won't you enter the 'NHK Mile 
Cup' too!?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Casually killing time with all my might, 
deee-su!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, don't be ridiculous... I refuse!!

El Condor Pasa's youthful blood yearns for 
battle. I could brush it off as 'talking 
nonsense', but...

"Still, I want to come up with something 
for them. Isn't there any way we can 
create an opportunity for them to test 
their strength against their peers, even 
just once?"
